title: Rear Naked Choke Threat
description: The attacker from Back Control is opening a path under the chin through Hand Fighting and chest-to-back connection.
topPlayerGoals: The top player wants to control Rear Naked Choke Threat through Head Position, Inside Position, and directed pressure.
Align the choking elbow, remove slack, and finish cleanly without neck cranking.
Keep a stable base so you are not off-balanced or countered.
bottomPlayerGoals: The bottom player wants to survive Rear Naked Choke Threat with frames, Pummeling, or the right angle.
Win the two-on-one, keep the chin safe, and put the shoulder on the mat.
Recognize danger signals early instead of waiting for the position to settle.
controlPoints: Main control point: Choking wrist, elbow line, and chest-to-back connection.
Head, hands, hips, and knees should share the same force direction.
The Elbow-Knee Connection or hip-shoulder line determines whether the position is still alive or already locked.
escapePriorities: Escape priority: Hand fight before clearing the hook.
Protect the neck, back, Knee Line, or arm line before countering.
If Inside Position is lost, reset one defensive layer first.

advancementOptions.action: The defender clears the choke line to enter an escape route
advancementOptions.why: This is the natural branch when you win the main control point and the opponent is forced to defend.

dangerSignals: The chin or neck is pulled out of a safe line.
The elbow separates from the ribs or knee.
The hip line is locked while the shoulder line is still being pulled.
You need a long hand post to avoid falling.
